items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he was taking lessons from the main bass teacher at Julliard, a guy by the name of Fred Zimmerman.

ctx.x: Do you remember who he was working with?

No, he was just, what we call freelancing, whoever had the gig. But, he had some place that lasted a long time, but who they were with, I don’t remember. That’s what he was doing. When I came east with Lionel, he was still there in the Bay Area. When I left Lionel, he was still there. Then, I started working around here, and then he decided he would come back here, and he came back here, and he was taking lessons from the main bass teacher at Julliard, a guy by the name of Fred Zimmerman. Zimmerman said, “You’re…

the time he came up, he wasn’t on the same level of the guys that were in the street, just for hitting it. He could read and all that stuff. So, that sort of put a split between us, which lasted for a while.
